findings.text: follow-on: /work/edas is now in excludes.path_prefixes yet remains a discovery_roots entry, so seed_facility_roots filters it out through should_exclude (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:502) and the root entry is inert; §24 names only /home for removal, so this is per-spec, but the now-dead root should be dropped once the exclusion is in place.

follow-on: the head gate log head-tests-config.log is headed at revision ffc7d03, the config commit, while the reviewed head is 2b55334, so the recorded 33-passed result is not keyed to the landed head; the docs commit changes no tested file so the result still holds, but the log should name the head it vouches for.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so its own record holds no measured added-failure pair and the count had to be re-derived from arms the reviewer ran (base 29 passed, head 33 passed, 0 added); recording the two arms would let the promotion audit read added failures without a second measurement.

item_verdicts.diff: two commits against base 126e80307 — ffc7d03 moves the three absolute excludes.directories entries to excludes.path_prefixes, prepends /home, removes the /home discovery root and adds a 41-line test; 2b55334 adds the 19-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the yaml move, the three should_exclude assertions, a recorded red arm and `uv run pytest tests/config` exiting 0; tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py asserts should_exclude returns true for /home/u/x and /work/edas/x and false for /analysis/src/x, the recorded gate log reads 33 passed EXIT=0, and I reproduced both the gate and the named mutation myself.
item_verdicts.goal: §24's config node asks the facility's absolute exclusions to move into excludes.path_prefixes with /home added there and /home dropped from discovery_roots, and the landed imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml does exactly that — path_prefixes at line 58 now holds /home, /tmp, /var/tmp and /work/edas and no /home entry remains under discovery_roots.
item_verdicts.manifest: present and self-consistent (status complete, commits ffc7d03 and 2b55334, changed_paths matching the yaml and test, head and negative-control logs named, a mutation note naming the Scratch copy); it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, and its head gate log header names ffc7d03 (the config commit) rather than the reviewed head 2b55334.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares four write paths (jt-60sa.yaml, tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py, the fragment and a docs/figures directory); the two commits touch exactly the yaml, the test file and the fragment, the granted figures directory is untouched, and the reviewed worktree is clean.

justifications.durability: I reinstated the regression — head with /home removed from path_prefixes — and tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py::test_home_subtree_excluded reddens (assert False is True, EXIT=1), and test_work_edas_subtree_excluded would redden against the base basename form because a basename directory never matches /work/edas/x, so the added assertions are sensitive to the defect they guard.
justifications.evidence: tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py exercises the exact paths the done_when names and the recorded log at ffc7d03 reads 33 passed EXIT=0; I re-ran tests/config at base 126e80307 (29 passed EXIT=0) and at head 2b55334 (33 passed EXIT=0) and reproduced the declared mutation (head with /home dropped from path_prefixes) failing test_home_subtree_excluded EXIT=1, with deduction only because the recorded green is headed at the config commit, not the landed head.
justifications.fit: path_prefixes is the exclusion family ExclusionConfig declares for absolute subtrees (imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:50) and should_exclude consults it first (line 155), the test follows the tests/config style, the fragment's element ids are node-prefixed, and both commit messages are conventional with no plan, ticket or AI trailer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml:58-62 now lists the absolute exclusions under excludes.path_prefixes with /home first and no longer names /home among discovery_roots (line 138), which is the whole of §24's config-node goal.
justifications.reuse: the change adds only configuration and a test and two commits; it extends the existing ExclusionConfig/merge_facility_excludes mechanism (imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:96-99) rather than forking it, and introduces no new capability to duplicate.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch only imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml, tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/jt60sa-exclusion-prefixes.html, all inside the declared write paths, with the granted figures directory unused.
